prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `GapValue`, `GapStyle`, and `expandGaps`.

`GapValue` is a number, a readonly pair of numbers, or a readonly four-number tuple. `GapStyle` supports `outerGap`, `innerGap`, the directional properties `outerTop`, `outerRight`, `outerBottom`, `outerLeft`, `innerTop`, `innerRight`, `innerBottom`, and `innerLeft`, plus arbitrary string-keyed properties.

`expandGaps(style: Readonly<GapStyle>): GapStyle` returns a new object. A scalar shorthand applies to all sides; a pair applies vertical then horizontal; four values apply top, right, bottom, left. All supplied spacing numbers must be finite, and any shorthand array of another length is malformed; throw `RangeError` in either case. Preserve shorthand and unrelated properties. A directional property that is an own property of the input must never be replaced, even when its value is explicitly `undefined`. Inherited properties do not count as explicit directional values. Do not mutate or return the input object.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
